QuestInfo.name: A Proper Fox
QuestInfo.0: Silver has something to suggest to you. You should talk to #bSilver#k.
QuestInfo.1:
Silver tells you to get paw stamps of adult foxes in the town to take the fox test.
You should go meet Timber, Compass, Patience, Brook, and Moonbeam in order to get their paw stamps.
QuestInfo.2: You passed the fox test, a coming-of-age ceremony, and were acknowledged as a proper fox.
